name: General Radiance Field (GRF)
definition: A neural network that implicitly represents and renders 3D objects and scenes from 2D observations by learning local features for each pixel in 2D images and projecting them to 3D points.
summary: General Radiance Field is a neural rendering method that learns 3D scene representations by projecting 2D image features into canonical space, distinguishing it from view-space approaches.
